notes: VS-21 (2026-09-21): Apple TV on the web, added at the person's ask ("Apple TV is one we still need to add too. That one is profiled per login"). Section 26: observe-only. No profiles script by design - the Apple Account is the profile. Everything beyond the match is to be read live once signed in. 0.2.0 (2026-09-23, 'Apple tv items are still not feeding much into my Watch page. Specifically the continue watching and my list lines'): signed-in marker, the Up Next collection as the list page, its reader. 0.3.0 (2026-09-23, 'We need all the controls added for the new Apple TV content too'): the player - context, commands, seek, play (to the resume point), My List add/remove. 2026-09-25: a press of Play whose player never loads (Foundation S2 E9: Apple's playback dialog opened and stayed empty, 'is-initial-load', with no video; the pick timed out) - 10 s after the press with no video the page is loaded again and Play pressed once more, the fix by hand made automatic. 2026-09-25 (later): the reload did not help - the press came about a second into the page's load, before its player (amp-video-player, MusicKit's components at ~1.6 s) was there, so the playback dialog opened with nothing to load it; Play is pressed only once the document is complete, amp-video-player is defined and 2.5 s have passed (a standard page check, no Apple function called); the look runs 35 s. 2026-09-25: episodes read after the row settles ('the episode list is wrong though, only shows 6 e in S1, no S2 and beyond' - Foundation): the read began 1.9 s into the show page's load, while its episode row held 6 of 30, and finished on that; it now waits for the page loaded 2.5 s and the row's length steady for 1.2 s, and follows the row if the page draws it anew. The row sits below the page's fold and Apple draws only the cards in view: it is brought into view before the sweep, 600 ms a step. 2026-09-25: the first read took ~15 s ('took ~15 seconds to populate'): the row counts as settled after 1.5 s loaded and 0.8 s steady, and the sweep steps nearly a full row width at 450 ms. 2026-09-25: the player's own chrome showed behind the wall's controls on a paused episode ('I see some of apple's chrome hiding behind my controls'): its progress bar (amp-playback-controls-progress), jump-to-live control and Info / Continue Watching tabs (.video-player__tabs) are hidden with the rest. 2026-09-25: (later) the scrim still showed on a pause - its dark gradient and the title footer (S1, E1 - The Emperor's Peace / Foundation): .video-player-scrim is hidden whole, the wall's controls in its place. 2026-09-25: (later still) 'Same thing, I see their chrome when I pause': the page held nothing visible - the player's fullscreen is the bare <video> element, and Chromium draws its own media controls over a fullscreen video on a pause; they are hidden (::-webkit-media-controls).

verified.videoLibrary: read live 2026-09-23 on the person's signed-in session (hidden page): Apple's Up Next is one collection - the home page's 'Continue Watching on Apple TV' row opens it at /us/shelf/continue-watching-on-apple-tv/uts.col.ChannelUpNext.tvs.sbd.4000 (the ctx_* query kept: without it the address lands on an empty /us/collection/). 44 cards, each an li with a[href] /us/episode|movie|show/<slug>/<umc id> (episodes carry ?showId=), a span label 'Ted Lasso, Yes & Baby, S4, E7, 41 min left' (a film: 'Eternity, 1 hr 56 min left'; a show added and not started: its name) and a leaf div 'S4, E7 . 41m' or 'In Watchlist'. Continue Watching = the episodes and films (in progress, or the next episode up); My List = the 'In Watchlist' cards (Apple's watchlist). Read only on that collection page - the home page's other rows (Formula 1, promotions) are not the person's. 40 + 4 read. 2026-09-23 ("I see several apple titles on the screen that didn't load an image"): Apple's art is .webp from is1-ssl.mzstatic.com, which Windows draws only with its WebP extension; the same address with .jpg serves the JPEG, so the reader asks for that.
verified.videoPlayer: read live 2026-09-23 on the person's session (hidden, muted): Apple's web player is the amp-* components in shadow roots (amp-playback-controls-play, -skip, -progress-range 'Playback Progress', amp-captions-control, amp-audio-tracks-control, amp-playback-controls-full-screen); no player object exposed. The content video is the one not inside amp-background-video (the hero preview). The page title names what plays: 'Watch Yes & Baby - Ted Lasso (Season 4, Episode 7) - Apple TV' (a film: 'Watch <title> - Apple TV') - with a no-break space inside 'Apple TV', so the readers end their patterns at '- Apple'. A direct currentTime change seeks (trailer 28 -> 48, playing on). The episode page's Play (capsule-button theme-primary, 'Play S4, E7') started from 0 though the Up Next card said 41 min left - the play jumps to the time left the Up Next reader keeps (localStorage __prismAtvLeft). The watchlist toggle is the capsule 'Added' / 'Add' (theme-secondary circle), a plain press flips it (Loot flipped and back). Captions / audio tracks, episodes and next-episode are still to read.
verified.videoTracks: read and pressed live 2026-09-23 on a Ted Lasso trailer (hidden, muted; never the person's episodes): the Subtitles control (button aria-label 'Subtitles' in amp-captions-control) opens an amp-contextual-menu - items On / Off (button[title]; the current one carries the checkmark svg in its icon container) and Language, a native select of 84 options (English, English CC, Arabic ...). The menu is built on the first open, so the first ask opens it. A pick sets the select and presses On; Off presses Off. English: one text track 'showing' with live cues ('Three. Two. One.'), drawn by the browser; Off: none showing. No audio alternatives on a trailer.
verified.css: read live 2026-09-23: the player's chrome is amp-* elements in the page (amp-playback-controls-unified, amp-volume-control-unified, amp-captions-control, amp-playback-controls-full-screen, amp-tv-overlay, amp-overlay with the rating), held at opacity 0 without pointer events - scripted presses still land; captions are the video's own and unaffected.
verified.videoCmd.more: 2026-09-23: next episode / skip intro press Apple's own buttons by their words when they show (not seen on a trailer - to verify on the wall); captions toggles English and Off through videoTracks.
verified.videoLookup: 2026-09-23: tv.apple.com/search?term= lists its results as a[aria-label] links to /us/show/<slug>/umc.cmc.<id> (a series) or /movie/ (Severance: 5 results, Severance first); read page-side, the ?ctx_agid tracking query dropped.
verified.videoEpisodes: 2026-09-23: a show page (/us/show/<slug>/<umc id>, found through videoLookup - an episode address would start playback) holds every season in ONE horizontal shelf (ul[data-testid=shelf-item-list], Severance 9 + 10 items); items render only as they scroll into view and stay, so one sweep across then read. No season mark per item: the numbering restarts ('EPISODE 1'), in the order of the season select's options (select[data-testid=accessory-button-select] 'Season 1', 'Season 2'). Each lockup: EPISODE N | title | synopsis | length ('54m', '1h 25m'); its href /us/episode/<slug>/<umc id>?showId= is what a pick plays.
verified.videoRemoveContinue: 2026-09-23: Apple keeps one Up Next list - an Up Next card's own MORE menu reads Remove from Watchlist / Mark as Watched / Go to Episode / Share, and only some cards carry it (the first 20 of the collection none; it opens only for real input). So the remove is the title's details page Watchlist toggle (the capsule 'Added' -> 'Add', as videoListSet): a show's page from the Up Next episode's ?showId= (/us/show/x/<id> redirects to its slug; read on Ted Lasso: 'Play Episode' + 'Added', only the muted background trailer), a film's own page. An episode's own page is never opened. A title in Up Next only because it is part way through reads 'Add' - said so, not pressed. The remove itself not pressed on the household's list.
verified.videoListSetUrl: 2026-09-23: the show's page first (an Up Next episode's ?showId=), then the card's own address (a Watchlist series' /show/ page, a film's /movie/ page) - never an episode's page.
verified.videoListSet: 2026-09-23: removals were not sticking - the show page's server-drawn 'Added' capsule is up before the page wakes and ignores a press until then (Extrapolations: four jobs 'the toggle did not change'; one press after the page had settled took it off, confirmed after reload). The toggle is pressed again every 2.5 s while it still reads the old state, up to four presses.
verified.videoPlaysAt: 2026-09-23: the addresses at which this service plays on load - never opened for background work (a Tubi /movies/ page opened for a list job played the film and kept it in Continue Watching).
